title: Exclude signed profit in the chronological BIT forward multi-donor screen
body:
All 23,849,569 chronological two-donor patterns were checked with the owner-411 bridge and its three tree packets protected. Each of the 184 graph edits that preserve the protected outputs passes the checked retained forward/adjoint interfaces, but loses signed margin under the optimistic extra-deletion grant. The best complete first-higher-trial balance is below −71.2760542616. All 525 named triple extensions also lose.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. Complements #7894's original-form omissions with compensated packet forms. python3 verify.py reproduces all 184 graph audits, directed invoices and independent chart/row/extra-charge controls. The packet-2947 priced geometry example retains a 65-main-row operator error. OpenAI Codex assisted; source contributors credited.

## Open next questions

Changed chronology, larger helper sets and triples whose protected terms cancel only jointly remain open.
